observations: Multiple used car engines and transmission units are shown in a workshop or storage area.
The central engine in the foreground is heavily rusted and has a large metal casing.
The background shows other engines and mechanical components.
The setting appears to be a used parts yard or garage.
No brand names, model numbers, or vehicle identification plates are visible on the engines.

claims.claim: never buy an item because it's cheap, cause you might not...

risks.risk: The engine may be a used, rebuilt, or rebuilt engine (R&R) rather than a new original equipment unit (OE).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine's identification plate (usually on the side or front).
risks.if_unproven: as a used or rebuilt engine

risks.risk: The engine may be missing its own cooling system (water pump, radiator, hoses).
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with its own cooling system components attached.
risks.if_unproven: as an engine without its own cooling system

risks.risk: The engine may have internal mechanical damage or high mileage.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a photo of the engine's service history documentation.
risks.if_unproven: as a high-mileage or damaged engine

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine's identification plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine with its own cooling system (radiator, hoses, pump).
Photo of the engine's service history or factory plate.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
